description: This file contains utility functions, classes, and logic for managing CUDA graph recording, mutation detection, and debugging in the context of PyTorch's Inductor backend, specifically related to CUDA graph optimization and profiling.

classes.name: FunctionID
classes.description: Unique identifier for a function wrapped in cudagraphify_impl.

classes.name: PlaceholderInfo
classes.description: Serializable info about a torch.fx.Node placeholder, including stack traces and user info for logging and error reporting.

classes.name: WrappedFunction
classes.description: Data structure representing a function intended for CUDA graph recording, with metadata for static inputs, constants, and placeholders.

classes.name: BoxedDeviceIndex
classes.description: Wrapper class for an optional device index, with a setter method.

classes.name: CheckInvariantStatus
classes.description: Enum representing status of invariant checks related to CUDA graph inputs and data pointers.

classes.name: CudagraphCachedInfo
classes.description: Stores information necessary for CUDA graph input realignment, including placeholders, stack traces, and failure reasons.

classes.name: CudagraphMetadata
classes.description: Contains metadata needed to record or validate CUDA graphs at the global level, including placeholders, input indices, stack traces, and constants.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_mutating_use_stack_trace_from_node( placeholder_node: torch.fx.Node, )
methods.description: Retrieves the stack trace of a mutating use from a torch.fx.Node, if available.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_mutating_use_stack_trace(placeholder_info: PlaceholderInfo)
methods.description: Returns the mutating use stack trace from a PlaceholderInfo object.

methods.name: PlaceholderInfo to_placeholder_info(placeholder_node: torch.fx.Node)
methods.description: Converts a torch.fx.Node to a PlaceholderInfo object, capturing relevant metadata.

methods.name: list[PlaceholderInfo] get_placeholder_info(graph: torch.fx.Graph)
methods.description: Extracts placeholder information from a torch.fx.Graph.

methods.name: str format_default_skip_message(reason: str)
methods.description: Formats a message indicating why cudagraphs are being skipped.

methods.name: str get_mutation_stack_trace( placeholders: Sequence[PlaceholderInfo], mutation_indices: Union[AbstractSet[int], Sequence[int]], )
methods.description: Generates a stack trace message for mutated inputs based on placeholders.

methods.name: Optional[str] check_for_mutation( func: WrappedFunction, inputs: list[InputType], is_cuda_graph_recorded_tensor: Callable[[torch.Tensor], bool], )
methods.description: Checks if there are mutations in the function inputs that prevent CUDA graph reuse, returning a reason if so.

methods.name: Optional[str] check_multiple_devices_or_any_cpu_nodes( device_node_mapping: dict[torch.device, torch.fx.Node], )
methods.description: Validates that the device-node mapping is suitable for CUDA graph recording, checking for multiple devices or CPU nodes.

methods.name: Optional[str] check_lowering_disable_cudagraph( device_node_mapping: dict[torch.device, torch.fx.Node], )
methods.description: Wrapper for device and CPU node checking during lowering to determine if CUDA graphs can be used.

methods.name: None log_cudagraph_skip_and_bump_counter(msg: str)
methods.description: Logs and updates counters when CUDA graph recording is skipped.

methods.name: Optional[str] check_for_mutation_ignore_cuda_graph_managed_tensor( gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, mutated_inputs: OrderedSet[str], mutated_input_idxs: OrderedSet[int], static_input_idxs: Sequence[int], )
methods.description: Performs mutation checks, ignoring CUDA graph-managed tensors if configured.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_placeholder_stack_trace(placeholder: PlaceholderInfo)
methods.description: Retrieves the first available stack trace from a PlaceholderInfo or its users.

methods.name: str log_data_ptr_mismatch( placeholders: Sequence[PlaceholderInfo], inputs: list[InputType], recorded_data_ptr: Sequence[Optional[int]], target_idxs: Sequence[int], mismatch: CheckInvariantStatus, )
methods.description: Logs discrepancies in data pointers between tensors and recorded metadata, indicating potential inconsistencies.

methods.name: bool maybe_warning_due_to_dynamic_shape( fn_cache: dict[tuple[int, ...], Callable[..., Any]], new_int_key: Any, )
methods.description: Issues a warning if too many distinct input sizes are recorded for dynamic shape support in CUDA graphs.

methods.name: CudagraphMetadata get_partition_cudagraph_metadata( partition_map: GraphPartitionMap, metadata: CudagraphMetadata, )
methods.description: Converts global CUDA graph metadata to per-partition metadata based on the partition map.

methods.name: OrderedSet[int] collect_cuda_data_ptrs(obj: object)
methods.description: Collects all CUDA data pointers from a nested object for debugging purposes.
